name: Hired Vehicle 4
definition: Vehicle for hire for passenger transport - excludes vehicles driven by a renter.  Examples include, but are not limited to, taxi, chauffeured limousine, boats.

CompanyType.name: Company Type
CompanyType.definition: Defines the type of company or vehicle being hired (for example, private, taxi, chauffeur service, rideshare).

CompanyName.name: Company Name
CompanyName.definition: Contains the name of the company that provided the hired vehicle services.

TypeOfVehicle.name: Type Of Vehicle
TypeOfVehicle.definition: Contains the type of vehicle that was hired (for example, limousine, black, SUV).

VehicleIdentification.name: Vehicle Identification
VehicleIdentification.definition: Contains the identifier assigned to the vehicle.

DriverIdentification.name: Driver Identification
DriverIdentification.definition: Contains the identifier assigned to the driver.

DriverTaxIdentification.name: Driver Tax Identification
DriverTaxIdentification.definition: Contains the tax identifier assigned to the driver.

DestinationNameAndLocation.name: Destination Name And Location
DestinationNameAndLocation.definition: Name and location of the destination.  May only contain the name if the location is specified elsewhere.
